Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can stay aligned with your buying committee.

Attendees (BrightPay):
- Sofia Alvarez (Project Lead)
- Raj Patel (CTO) 
- Liza Chen (Procurement / Security)

Redwood team: Marissa (AE), Aditya (Solutions Engineer), Neha (Security), Camila (Legal), Vivek (Customer Success)

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Performance: showed 99th percentile latency under 200ms on our standard config for the demo prompts.
- Cost: two preferred paths 
- Hosted API for fastest time-to-value or Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable unit economics.
- Security: Redwood Private offers VPC + KMS; SOC 2 Type II available (Neha will share artifacts).
- Integration: SSO + SCIM supported; we can provide a dedicated VPC and IP allowlist for production.

Decision criteria you called out:
1) Predictable latency under peak load
2) Unit cost at 1M+ tokens/month
3) SOC2 evidence + KMS/PII controls
4) Ability to deploy in a private VPC / on-prem option if required

Proposed next steps:
- I will share the initial SOW and a pricing estimate (attachment) for your review. (Aditya will finalize pricing details.)
- Neha will send the security questionnaire and SOC 2 artifacts.
- Camila will be standby for contract/legal questions and to pick up redlines.
- Can we lock a procurement sync with Raj and Liza on Friday 7/30 at 10:00 AM PT?

Attachments: BrightPay_SOW_v1.pdf (pricing + scope) 
- preliminary.
Security questionnaire will be sent separately (BrightPay_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).
